label: Simple skin avulsion, skin tear, or abrasion without repair need
inclusion_criteria: Adult with clinician diagnosis or discharge impression of simple skin abrasion, skin tear, or skin avulsion.
Clinician documents no repair need and no retained foreign body, deep structure injury, infection concern, or high-risk wound pathway.
Wound was cleaned and dressed with clinician-entered wound care instructions.
exclusion_criteria: Wound needing sutures, staples, glue, operative repair, or laceration pathway.

Burn, chemical exposure, high-pressure injection injury, crush injury, open fracture, joint violation, tendon/nerve/vascular concern, retained foreign body, bite wound, dirty wound, or infected wound.
Diabetic foot wound, immunocompromised host, pediatric pathway, or specialist-directed wound plan.
must_not_miss: Tendon, nerve, vascular, or joint injury.
default_follow_up: Follow up with primary care, urgent care, wound clinic, or the ED if the wound is not improving after 2 to 3 days, or sooner if your clinician gave a specific schedule.

source_audit.notes: MedlinePlus supports cuts, punctures, skin breaks, wound healing, infection warning signs, and escalation for deep, dirty, bite, puncture, foot, or high-risk wounds. ED-specific decisions about repair need, tetanus, topical agents, and wound severity require clinician-entered context.

output_modifiers.label: Diabetes wound-healing modifier
output_modifiers.note: Flag higher infection risk and confirm clinician-entered wound follow-up.

output_modifiers.label: Peripheral vascular disease wound-healing modifier
output_modifiers.note: Flag slower healing risk and confirm clinician-entered wound follow-up.

output_modifiers.label: Anticoagulation bleeding modifier
output_modifiers.note: Flag bleeding risk while preserving the simple-wound pathway.

output_modifiers.label: Delayed clean-wound presentation modifier
output_modifiers.note: For clean delayed wounds, confirm clinician-entered follow-up; contaminated or bite wounds remain blocked separately.

review.reviewer_role: Software pipeline; not a clinician signature
review.notes: Phase 222 clinician feedback applied. Approved for narrow ontology mode after high-risk wound modifier disposition was documented. Immunocompromised remains a true blocker for v1; diabetes, PVD, anticoagulation, and clean delayed presentation are output modifiers. No static tetanus or topical antibiotic language.
